page.notes: The paragraph ends at the foot with "mutari," followed by a stray mark that may be a comma or a faint catchword-like symbol; it is not transcribed as a catchword. The position of the left-margin notes is approximate: "Pupl.ad Pisc. c.1. p.6." sits level with "rantem." and "9. 6.", and "Armin. Antiperk. p. 746." sits level with "per partes" and "Et quid".
